_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed.
reason: 2026-08-04 21:15Z full cycle: scanned 557 candidates (--hours 168, discovery.py 3 queries, no fallback). National Bank Open tennis (Shang vs Rublev, $292k liquidity, top-volume candidate) description gives original scheduled start 2026-08-04 2:00PM ET = 18:00Z -- already 3h15m in the past at scan time despite end_date reading 2026-08-11 (the known tournament-level end_date artifact, DEEP-2026-08-03) -- in-play per established rule, skipped without researching further. Toronto Tempo vs Golden State Valkyries ML (real bookmaker line found: Toronto +675/GS -756, power-devig fair 0.1205/0.8795): live book Toronto ask 0.15 (edge -0.03, wrong side), GS ask 0.86 (edge 0.0195) -- both below min_edge_book_devig 0.07 on a 1c-spread book, matches the established sharp-counterparty prior, skipped. Circle (CRCL) beat-earnings market re-checked (price moved 0.70->0.82 since 18:15Z): current Street consensus EPS is $0.19 (revised down 7.87% over 30d) vs the market's fixed $0.16 threshold -- consensus already clears the bar by ~19%, which plausibly justifies a price above the ~70-85% base beat-rate band, but I have no quantified model for P(EPS>threshold | consensus, threshold-gap) beyond that qualitative read -- not a nameable, quantified edge per Estimation step 4, skipped rather than guess. LoL Hanwha Life Esports vs Gen.G (LCK, Aug 5 06:00 ET, pre-match, real candidate): only source found was an egamersworld 'prediction' tip conflating a different KeSPA Cup Aug-3 match, not scraped bookmaker odds for this LCK fixture -- fails coverage precondition, skipped as unresearchable. Tonight's MLB O/U slate (Angels/Orioles, Mets/Guardians, Cardinals/Yankees, Tigers/Mariners, Pirates/Brewers) not re-researched this cycle -- book-devig on tight MLB totals is an already-confirmed 0/7-then-12-clean-matches pattern (playbook edge class 3), not expected to yield new signal without a specific reason to recheck. No qualifying edge found this cycle; open-position monitor and settle still ran (d2dd24206542 mid improved slightly to ~0.265 from ~0.245, still adverse -0.655 from entry, 5 days past end date). Set next_full_cycle_after to 23:59Z (~2h45m, under the 3h cap) -- lets tonight's MLB slate finish (last first pitch 01:40Z) so resolve.py can pick up new settlements, and gives CRCL's report (tomorrow ~13:00Z, webcast 08:00 ET) more time to develop; 13 full cycles already ran in the last 24h vs min_full_cycles_per_day=4, so no urgency to force another immediately.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick.
